rv.q: But a show that should have the sweet, burning kick of a shot of Courvoisier tastes instead like a warm glass of milk.

The unevenness of the performances, however, is what keeps this Les Miserables from becoming the emotionally moving extravaganza of the 1987 original and the evening although still powerful feels disappointingly gutless.
The production itself rarely rises as far, as it's only willing to make changes that don't really matter.

cn.t: Critics find this revival of Les Misérables tired and uninspired, with performances that lack the passion and energy that made the show a phenomenon, though the scaled-down production retains some appeal.

vs.sum: One of Broadway's least comfortable theaters, with notoriously tight legroom and narrow seats. The lack of rake means tall patrons in front block your view. Restrooms are in the basement, creating long intermission lines. For legroom, target Row A or N in Orchestra.

acc.note: 6 wheelchair spaces in Orchestra. No steps from sidewalk. Infrared devices available.
